definition: [ רָטַשׁ ] verb Pi`el dash in pieces (compare ᵑ7 רְטַשׁ cast away, reject; but possibly akin to לָטַשׁ ); — Pi`el Imperfect 2 masculine singular תְּרַטֵּשׁ 2Kgs 8:12 their children thou will dash in pieces ; 3 feminine plural קְשָׁתוֺת נְעָרִים תְּרַטַּשְׁנָה Isa 13:18 , but probably corrupt, Du conjecture נְעָרוֺת תְּרֻטַּשְׁנָה compare Che . Pu`al Perfect 3 feminine singular אֵם עַלֿ בָּנִים רֻטָּ֑שָׁה Hos 14:14 Imperfect 3 masculine plural יְרֻטְּשׁוּ Isa 13:16 ; Nah 3:10 , יְרֻטָּ֑שׁוּ Hos 14:1 , all of children. רִי see רוה .

Pi`el Imperfect 2 masculine singular תְּרַטֵּשׁ 2Kgs 8:12 their children thou will dash in pieces; 3 feminine plural קְשָׁתוֺת נְעָרִים תְּרַטַּשְׁנָה Isa 13:18, but probably corrupt, Du conjecture נְעָרוֺת תְּרֻטַּשְׁנָה compare Che. Pu`al Perfect 3 feminine singular אֵם עַלֿ בָּנִים רֻטָּ֑שָׁה Hos 14:14 Imperfect 3 masculine plural יְרֻטְּשׁוּ Isa 13:16; Nah 3:10, יְרֻטָּ֑שׁוּ Hos 14:1, all of children.

רִי see רוה.
